newsitem.title: CANADA: CAE awarded C$21-million German contract.
newsitem.headline: CAE awarded C$21-million German contract.

text.p: CAE Inc said on Thursday that its German subsidiary, CAE Elektronik GmbH, had won a C$21-million (US$15.3 million) contract to supply the German Air Force with a Tornado full mission simulator.
The simulator, the eighth to be built for the Germans by CAE, will be delivered at the beginning of 2000 to the tactical training command of the German Air Force.

"It (the simulator) will be used both both for biennial Tornado tactical training and extended top-grade training for pilots and weapons system officers of the German Air Force," CAE said in a statement.

The simulator would include an instruction and debriefing station, a digital radar land mass system, a digital communication and sound system and a system enabling simulation of acceleration forces, CAE said.
Staff members at the German subsidiary would continue supporting the system after on-site acceptance, CAE added.
